issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing "site can't be reached" for three days; the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on their own domain, and the dashboard showed "Not connected" next to the domain.

issues.title: Secure certificate padlock after connecting
issues.problem_statement: After the domain was connected, support noted the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear; the customer did not report a problem with it.

items.description: Support explained that the customer's old A record for "shop", pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection, and that it should be deleted and replaced with a CNAME record for "shop" using the target value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.
add a CNAME record for shop, using the target value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for "shop" with the target value from the FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance, and saved it; support then saw the dashboard show the domain as connected and the customer confirmed the domain loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Support explained that the www version still showed an error because a second record for "www" pointed somewhere else, and that it should be deleted and replaced with a CNAME record for "www" with the same target value.
evidence: That is because you have a second record for www pointing somewhere else.

items.description: Customer deleted the second record for "www" and added a CNAME record for "www" with the same target value, following support's guidance, saved both changes, and confirmed that both the shop and www versions now load their funnel.
Support said the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
